g.text: view-plan: execution-time targets and exact daily excesses
Parser supplies both lambdas when constructing the command; parsing is omitted.
formatDay first formats meals; formatDailyTotals then sums
the day's MealSummary nutrition with mapToLong(...).sum().
Construct NutritionTotals for actual daily values.
For each nutrient: zero if target is null or actual <= target;
otherwise actual - target. Generation tolerance is not applied.
Construct a new NutritionTotals containing the excesses.
Read targets and excesses; formatWarning emits a line only for
a positive excess. Order: calories, protein, carbs, fats.
Place warnings after daily totals and before the closing separator.
Supplier calls depict the default shared-state parser configuration.
Null-source programming errors are omitted. An invalid upper day bound does not read targets.
Empty-plan viewing delegates through the no-target overload; there is no active-state mutation.
